subject: Unable to play WoF
body:
Dear Amir,

 

We would like to let you know that we are experiencing some issues with the Wheel of Fourte. The activity is not responding, and it takes time to load. Also, some participants have reported that it returns an error message ‘Sorry something went wrong’.

The issue started on 08/10/2024 and we have done some testing as well using the latest version of the App.

 

If you could please investigate the issue.

 

Regards

Onie

body:
Hi Thulile
I hope you're doing well. I'm Amin, filling in for my colleague Ahmad.
I'm so sorry for the late response, I just realized that my yesterday's email was failed.
We reviewed your issue yesterday and found the root cause. I have assigned it to one my colleagues, Amir Mohammad and he's currently working on a fix. I want to let you know that we're so sorry for the inconvenience this is causing and we're working around the clock to make up for it and fix issue. Since it's a complicated issue, the fix might take a few days to be fully deployed. You can expect the fix to be deployed by the end of Sunday.

Best regards,
Amin
